I replied in the thread on your message in #inc-vtg-hartford.

You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. The channel's only note on the guard is from that same message: they were writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Mateo's 11:03 AM message says kiosk 1 was back and the guard checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. Your 11:08 AM update says both lanes were working as of 11:07.
